name: Trapper cuts the cooldown of trap spells by 25% (#1050)
contract: Trapper 681180 (installed Spell.dbc) is a passive family-21 spell with one effect: SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108), misc 11 = SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN, base -26 die 1 -> -25, SpellClassMask[2] 0x40000. Inquisitor's Trap 681445 and Death Trap 681450 both carry SpellFamilyFlags[2] 0x40000 and a 60000 ms cooldown; Player::AddSpellAndCategoryCooldowns runs the recovery time through ApplySpellMod(SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN). The Description reads 'Reduces the cooldown of your Trap spells by 25%.' 60000 * 0.75 = 45000. The native modifier query is checked on Death Trap (45000) and on Guard Strike 804432 (family flag [1] 0x2000, not a trap, 18000 unchanged); the real casts then confirm the running cooldown is 45 s for the holder against a full minute for an untalented control. The cooldown is read within 2 s of the cast, so the band's lower edge is 2 s below the ideal value.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Control: a trap's 60 s cooldown is untouched
Trapper: a trap's 60 s cooldown becomes 45 s
Trapper: a non-trap 18 s cooldown (Guard Strike) is untouched
Control's Inquisitor's Trap cooldown is the full minute
Trapper's Inquisitor's Trap cooldown is 45 seconds
Control's Death Trap cooldown is the full minute
Trapper's Death Trap cooldown is 45 seconds
